_readme: Your own words: names, companies, places, product names.
A proper noun that is not a Japanese word is the one thing the recogniser
cannot guess. It does not fail quietly -- it substitutes something that
sounds similar and is confident about it. Measured on a real run:
spoken  'タリクールイスラム'  ->  returned '誰くりすらむ'      conf 0.989
spoken  'バングラデシュ'      ->  returned 'バングラデーション' conf 0.997
Adding the term here is what stops that.
* Write each term the way you want it to APPEAR in the transcript.
* Japanese script for Japanese sessions (katakana for foreign names).
* Restart the session after editing -- terms are read at Start.
* Up to 100 terms in total, shared with the built-in business list.
Yours are kept first, so the built-ins are dropped before yours are.
* A line starting with # is ignored, so you can leave notes.
This file is edited by hand and never written by the app. If it is missing
or malformed, it simply means 'no extra terms' and the session still starts.
